summary.text: Molly Jenkins is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 33 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former teacher and adjunct professor, she advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Molly Jenkins earned a high school diploma from Putnam City High School, a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University and a master's degree from the University of Central Oklahoma.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher and adjunct professor.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she spent more than a decade in public education as a middle school teacher and adjunct professor, later owned and operated a real estate brokerage, and lives on a ranch near Coyle where she and her husband raise cattle.
Jenkins assumed office on November 20, 2024, succeeding John Talley, and for 2025-2026 was vice chair of the Administrative Rules Committee.
In the survey, she listed her key messages as limited government, transparency and accountability, the sanctity of life, the Second Amendment, lower taxes, parental rights and medical freedom.
